caption: The drawing depicts a single shoe, shown in profile view facing to the right. The shoe is primarily green, with a matte finish and a smooth texture. It features a low ankle height and is laced at the side with green laces that are threaded through eyelets in a crisscross pattern, ending in a bow near the top edge. The toe cap and heel of the shoe are both colored black, while the sole is brown. The inner lining of the shoe, visible at the opening, is a lighter, tan color. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Woman's Shoe
